swarm_objective: Explain the drivers and constraints of NVIDIA and AMD's AI data-center growth, supported by filings, earnings calls and industry sources.

agents.directive: Investigate how hyperscaler AI capital expenditure (Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta) translates into demand for NVIDIA and AMD data-center accelerators, with cited sources.
constraints: Every numeric claim must cite a source.
Tie every capex figure back to NVIDIA or AMD accelerator demand.
success_criteria: Capex figures or guidance for at least two hyperscalers.
Evidence linking that spend to NVIDIA or AMD accelerators.

agents.directive: Assess high-bandwidth memory (HBM) supply from SK hynix, Samsung and Micron as a constraint on NVIDIA and AMD accelerator output, with cited sources.
constraints: Every numeric claim must cite a source.
Tie every memory-supplier fact back to NVIDIA or AMD accelerators.
success_criteria: HBM capacity or share figures for at least two suppliers.
At least one concrete effect on NVIDIA or AMD accelerator supply.

agents.directive: Investigate NVIDIA's data-center networking business (InfiniBand, Spectrum-X Ethernet, NVLink) revenue and growth since fiscal 2024, with cited sources.
constraints: Every numeric claim must cite a source.
Compute GPU revenue only as brief context.
success_criteria: Networking revenue for at least two periods, with growth.
At least two named networking growth drivers.
